inclusion_rule: A file is published if a number reported in the manuscript or in the diagnostic results document is stored in it, or if the Data Availability statement promises it. No detector or analysis code and no ClassEval or repository source text is published; block-level records carry line positions and labels only.

files.results/task_class/test_pass.json: ClassEval test outcome per class (Table 2, Pass)
files.results/task_class/syntactic_validity.js: parse and salvage counts per producer (Table 2, Salv.)
files.results/task_class/validation.json: agreement with lizard over 6,540 matched methods (Section 3.2)
files.results/task_class/task_scope.json: task-class identification, dropped files, multi-class files (Section 3.2)
reconciliation of the 421 whole-file and 267 task-class blocks (Table S3)
files.results/task_class/main_results.json: corpus flags, block audit, duplication contrasts, subsets, count models, echo, later cohort (Tables 2, 4, 6; Sections 4.1-4.3)
files.results/task_class/paired_contrasts.json: task-paired contrasts and presence odds ratios (Section 4.3.1)
files.results/task_class/size_models.json: size-adjusted models, full and common size range (Table 5; Table S2)
files.results/task_class/size_sensitivity.json: dense core, extrapolation and task fixed effects (Section 4.3.2; Table S1)
files.results/task_class/size_exponent.json: free log(SLOC) exponent under both rules (Section 3.4; Figure S1)
files.results/repository/oss_large.json: repository sample, per-repository results and pinned commit SHAs
statement-free share, AI minus human, deduplicated repositories (Section 4.3.7)
files.results/repository/copy_verification.jso: verification of repository copies used for deduplication
files.results/scope_compare.json: every estimate under the whole-file configuration and the task class side by side (Table 7)
per-class counts and densities under both rules, with completeness, salvage and test flags
files.results/task_class/flagged_blocks.csv: every flagged block: position, line labels, statement-free flag, skeleton match
files.results/whole_file_config/per_class_both: per-class counts and densities under both rules, with completeness, salvage and test flags
files.results/whole_file_config/flagged_blocks: every flagged block: position, line labels, statement-free flag, skeleton match
files.docs/diagnostic_results.pdf: diagnostic results cited in the manuscript as Tables S1-S7 and Figure S1
